description: Returns every GTM container (gtm.js) and Google tag (gtag/js) this audit's pages loaded so far, and how each reached the page: a script tag in the HTML, the inline snippet, another script (named by its address, such as a consent platform), a Custom HTML tag or a Google tag in another GTM container, a container loading another itself (a Zone or a tag template), a gtag('config') command, an event's send_to with no config, or a destination of the Google tag. Also the dataLayer each reads, whether it was served from the site's own domain, the GTM environment when one is named, and the step it loaded at. Duplicates, GTM environments and split dataLayers are flagged by finish_audit.
name: get_containers
title: List the Google containers loaded so far
